Refine ONLY those existing worn-clothing regions: forest-green beret and shoulder cape, warm gold trim and small acorn necklace if present. Add restrained crisp pixel-art fabric shading/folds and readable maple-leaf emblems, keeping the exact drawn silhouette and all per-frame positions. Do NOT redraw or move any original face, fur, ears, beard, paws, tail, effects, pose or sprite dimensions. Keep original pixel blocks (8 display px/native body pixel,4px/fine clothing pixel), hard edges, continuous even-width gold trim and sloped hem. The same outfit must stay visually consistent across this animation cycle: same leaf designs, lighting direction, fabric colours and trim thickness; no random ornament changes or flicker. Do not insert a necklace in frames where it is hidden. No isolated accessory templates, new tigers, extra frames, text, antialiasing, blur or backdrop glow. Preserve exact panel layout and genuine transparency. Output complete dressed frames in their original cells, only the painted clothing improved.
Motion: move. Exactly4 frames in2columns and2rows,1024x1024 canvas. Preserve each original frame's individual posture.
